parsed.rationale: Both members are unnamed extensions on (presumably) `UserDefaults` within the same `Caching` package, living in two separate files: `UserDefaults+WXYC.swift` (line 15) and `DefaultsStorage.swift` (line 47). Having two extension declarations on the same type scattered across files in the same package creates a name-collision signal and makes it harder to reason about the full surface area of the extension. Since both records share `package: "Caching"`, neither is test, codegen, mock, nor sample-app code, consolidating them into a single canonical extension file (e.g., `UserDefaults+WXYC.swift`) is the idiomatic Swift approach. Any members from `DefaultsStorage.swift` that belong to the `UserDefaults` extension should be moved there, leaving `DefaultsStorage.swift` to hold only non-extension declarations.
